message.content: {"caption":"Induction-task training curves comparing reward and token length for Solve and Propose.","description":"Two side-by-side line charts plot Training Steps on the horizontal axes, from 0 to 280. The legend identifies Solve in blue-purple and Propose in salmon. The left chart has Reward on the vertical axis, scaled from 0 to 0.7. Solve rises from about 0.05 to around 0.55 by step 80, stays mostly near 0.5 through about step 200, then fluctuates downward before ending near 0.45. Propose starts near zero, rises more gradually, has a brief spike to about 0.34 near step 115, then mostly remains around 0.15–0.25 and ends near 0.30. Solve reward is higher than Propose for most of training. The right chart has Token Length on the right vertical axis, scaled from about 250 to 2,000. Solve begins around 450 tokens, falls to roughly 300 around steps 40–60, then fluctuates, with a sharp peak near 1,750 around step 113. It drops back to roughly 700–800 and later rises sharply after step 240, ending around 1,250. Propose begins around 600 tokens, briefly rises near step 60 to about 1,500, falls, then has another peak near step 118 at about 1,200; thereafter it generally trends down toward roughly 600 by the end. Values in chart_values are estimated read-offs from the plotted curves, not printed point
